Items: muesli bowl (~50 g, ~180 kcal), canned peach pieces (~80 g, ~50 kcal), Greek-style yogurt (~150 g, ~140 kcal), latte (~200 ml with milk, ~90 kcal).

Served total: ~460 kcal.

The photo shows the meal before eating, so I assumed a small leftover of about 30 kcal, which gives about 430 kcal eaten.

Macros for the full meal:
- Muesli (50 g): protein 6, carbs 31, fat 6
- Peaches: protein 0.5, carbs 12, fat 0
- Yogurt (150 g): protein 8, carbs 6, fat 8
- Latte: protein 6, carbs 9, fat 5
- Total: protein ~20.5, carbs ~58, fat ~19

Scaling these down by about 6% for the leftover gives protein 19, carbs 54, fat 18.
